description: This Java class 'Utils' provides static utility methods related to Android activity lifecycle management, specifically printing activity status and lifecycle methods to TextViews with delayed execution.

classes.name: Utils
classes.description: A utility class for printing activity lifecycle states and statuses for debugging or display purposes.

methods.name: printStatus
methods.description: Schedules a delayed task to fetch and display the list of lifecycle methods called and the status of all activities in provided TextViews.
